summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the Investor Privilège (FCRL) feature. All 14 pytest cases passed (public packs, subscribe validation, TRANSFER + STRIPE flows, 409 duplicate, /me credits, admin registry, admin activation + idempotency, user + admin PDF). Frontend: /investisseurs-privilege displays 3 packs with correct amounts (50 000 / 57 500, 150 000 / 180 000, 500 000 / 650 000 - using French narrow no-break space), cycle/guarantees/pass-impact sections and header-back-button all visible. Subscribe dialog flow (signer + company + accept + method=transfer + submit) returns FCRL reference in privilege-transfer-info. /espace-investisseur widget shows the subscription. Superadmin /superadmin -> Achat-Revente tab exposes privilege-registry with stats, filters and activation button; clicking activate transitions status to Actif, updates stats (1 actif, 50 000 € collecté, 57 500 € émis) and shows toast 'Pack activé — crédits bonifiés attribués'. Test data cleaned up post-run (subs deleted, marie.is_investor=false, invest.test.i.is_investor=true).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_privilege_packs.py: numeric formatting uses .replace(',', ' ') on strings that already contain commas from Python f-string ':,' — acceptable workaround but brittle if any French label happens to contain commas (currently safe).
PrivilegePackWidget: PDF download uses fetch with getAuthHeaders + credentials:'include' which is fine; consider handling non-200 with error text from JSON to give clearer feedback.
